whatIsEchodesk.question: What is EchoDesk?
whatIsEchodesk.answer: EchoDesk is an all-in-one business platform for Georgian SMBs. One workspace for WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, email, SIP phone calls, tickets, invoices, bookings, and leave management — billed in Georgian Lari.

channels.question: Can I reply to WhatsApp, Messenger, and email from one inbox?
channels.answer: Yes. Every conversation lands in the same inbox regardless of channel. Your team picks up where the customer left off, with full history attached to the client record.

calling.question: Do you support SIP calling?
calling.answer: Yes — EchoDesk ships with a built-in SIP PBX. Connect your Georgian provider (Magti, Silknet or any SIP trunk), assign extensions to your employees, and record calls directly against the client's ticket history.

gelBilling.question: Is EchoDesk billed in Georgian Lari?
gelBilling.answer: Yes, all pricing is in GEL and payments are processed through Bank of Georgia. No foreign currency conversion, no surprise invoices.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes — every new workspace gets 30 days free, no card needed. You can invite your team, connect channels and publish invoices during the trial — nothing is locked. Add a card before the trial ends to keep going.

competitors.question: How is EchoDesk different from Kommo, Bitrix24, or Zendesk?
competitors.answer: EchoDesk is pay-per-module, priced in GEL, and supports Georgian businesses out of the box: local SIP providers, GEL invoices, Bank of Georgia payments and Tbilisi-based support. International tools charge in USD and don't integrate with Georgian telephony or accounting.

dataResidency.question: Where is my data stored?
dataResidency.answer: Data is stored on servers in Germany (EU), hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH. Tenant isolation is enforced at the database level — your conversations and invoices never touch another customer's schema.
